description: Ratchet for #2675: per feature file, how many scenarios name their own platform tag(s) but also inherit a wider platform claim from the file-level tag line (Gherkin tags are additive, so a `@desktop` scenario under a file headed `@ios @android` is selected by the iOS/Android runners and credited to them). validate-coverage fails when a file's count rises or a new file appears. Lower it by moving the scenario to a file whose header says what it means, or by moving the file-level tags onto the scenarios - never by raising the number. Regenerate with: bun run test-specs:validate --write-widening-baseline
